newsitem.title: SPAIN: Spain's Vitoria air cargo traffic up 33pct in Dec.
newsitem.headline: Spain's Vitoria air cargo traffic up 33pct in Dec.

text.p: Cargo traffic at Vitoria airport in northern Spain rose by 33 percent in December to 2,957 tonnes from 2,226 tonnes in the same month 1995, the airport authority said.
This takes the accumulated total for the year to 26,721 tonnes against 13,782 tonnes in 1995.

Vitoria, which started commercial cargo operations in 1994, has been showing monthly growth rates of as much as 150 percent this year and is becoming an important national centre for frozen fish and express package freight. Reuters Air Cargo Newsroom Tel+44 171 542 7706 Fax 5017
